title: Deterministic failures in Replay Vision activities raise non-retryable ApplicationError
answers: how to stop temporal retrying a missing ExportedAsset
body:
Convention: when a failure can't recover on retry (a row is gone, a rendered object is missing), raise `temporalio.exceptions.ApplicationError(..., non_retryable=True)`. Don't let a raw exception use up the retry chain.
Example: products/replay_vision/backend/temporal/activities/observation_media.py:prepare_observation_thumbnail_activity wraps `ExportedAsset.objects.aget` and turns `ExportedAsset.DoesNotExist` into a non-retryable error, the same way it handles an empty `content_location`.
Test pattern, in products/replay_vision/backend/tests/test_observation_media.py: delete the fixture, call the activity, then assert `pytest.raises(ApplicationError)` and `caught.value.non_retryable is True`.
applies: Replay Vision Temporal activities with deterministic error paths
